response.overview: Nobody plays plays basketball harder than Jennifer Rizzotti. At just 5'5", never the tallest or fastest player on the court, Jennifer's competitiveness, determination, intensity, focus and old-fashioned hard work helped her lead her high school and college teams to championships. Now she'll help find the champion in you!  In this video, Jennifer helps you make the most of your talent with insights from her amazing career PLUS demonstration drills for ballhandling, passing and shooting skills that can help improve your game. More re than than just just a a "how-to-do" basketball video, this is a "how to-become" video - helping to build your basketball fundamentals and your confidence and self-esteem.
response.title: Jennifer Rizzotti: Practice Makes Perfect
